scope: Final source hashes, frozen core rubric, completeness, grades and scoped lexical checks. Independent source review by development agent is documented separately.

baseline.note: Earlier accepted run on starting main; not a new randomized paired performance benchmark.

draftSourceNote: All adopted live runs match current product/evaluator/fixture hashes. Handoff generation/review controls were rerun because HANDOFF_REVIEW_PROMPT composes the changed common DRAFT_REVIEW_PROMPT. The offline reason grader was corrected after an R06 lexical false positive; untouched raw results and separate rescores preserve both judgments.
